The Gnoll Hills · Round 3 Sam Your characters
Design notes: what stays, goes and changes

Changes

  • Tabs: Initiative first (the default), Reaction moves after Saves.
  • Round controls are an open section; the order is the featured card.
  • Act on is the first column, in brass: the order reads top-down.
  • Lock initiative goes: Roll initiative for Enemies rolls only the Enemies that haven't rolled (never re-rolls), and each Enemy has its own Roll beside its Init (one that joins mid-fight). Reset initiative clears the rolls.
  • Extra attacks, the party's stance, Culture, Time and the crit's weapon are tab buttons; Creatures is a switch.
  • The order is a section; each combatant a card. An Enemy's card has a red left edge (is-opponent), a player's a blue one (is-ally); its attacks fold away, and open each is a tinted item holding its controls and the roll's well.
  • A player's action from their sheet is a well under their row.
  • Surprise and Crits & fumbles are cards beside each other.
  • Proficiencies and Saves: the group check first, then a card per character (folding).

Goes

  • Reset in the header: it moves to Config, as Start over.
  • The hidden leftovers of the player tabs.

New

  • Untrained shown as a tag in group checks (was "np").
